notes.title: Ecosphere's Kickstarter is live!
notes.notes:
Here we are! Ecosphere's Kickstarter is live!

After two years of development, the project is already well advanced: character sprites, backgrounds, and OST are funded. But we have also created 60% of the CGs! That's why we launched this crowdfunding campaign!

Art and music are commissioned from freelance artists. Demo and OST were paid for entirely out of the director's own pocket. For the complete game, a co-financer helped us with backgrounds, character sprites, and half of the CGs.

To complete the game, we are launching this Kickstarter campaign: you can join us to bring this project to life with [b]charming additional illustrations[/b]!

notes.title: New Demo Available!
notes.notes:
After several months of work and iterations, here's the new Ecosphere-Demo, for the VN Steam Fest!

You can get to know the main characters through the first hour (approx.) of gameplay. The demo follows directly from the Prologue released in December 2022. As Creative Director, I know that development time is fairly long for a VN, but this allows us to offer you the best possible technical rendering! I'm pleased with the progress I've made in programming over the last few months. My team of artists also gives their all to achieve the best artistic and musical direction. ːsteamhappyː

We've kept the point-and-click exploration mechanics and dynamic QTE choices from the previous demo. But we've completely overhauled the drag-and-drop system to simplify it, while still allowing you to interact with the backgrounds.

Although the basics are there, the sound design is still highly perfectible and will be fine-tuned in the future!

We hope you enjoy this universe as much as we enjoy creating it! Don't hesitate to give us your feedback in the Steam Community or on our social networks to further improve the project ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Extended Demo soon!
notes.notes:
We're working on a [b]new Demo[/b] to show you the first hour of the story. It follows on directly from the Prologue! The various versions of the current demo and your feedback have enabled us to fine-tune the Point & Click and QTE mechanics, to strike the right balance with the particular gameplay of visual novels. This extended demo will allow us to delve deeper into the lore, the characters, and their relationships. You'll meet a romanceable new character: Zael Collins. He left the MC (Arane Kross) village four years before the story began, to join the Green League... Their reunion promises to be eventful!

We expect it to be [b]available this Fall[/b] ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388138/0bec5f9ca17cef17ae0323145ae14da7575ccf5d.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Camp 2024
notes.notes:
Last week we were at Game Camp 2024, the annual gathering of the [b]French video game industry[/b] ! We exhibited the demo at the Plaine images stand, and the professionals who tested the game gave us positive and encouraging feedback !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388138/913c6c301ed1c74ae76f0bc1cfb023d68f01748d.jpg[/img]

Plaine images is a [b]French incubator[/b] for innovative projects in the cultural and creative industries, including video games ! Since January 2023, they've been working with us on this adventure, helping us greatly improve the project's rendering to deliver the best gaming experience, as you've probably noticed between the V1 Prologue and the latest demo version !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388138/8df0d6a360b442921d13e6fabaea22ea78b30592.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Storyteller's Festival & Demo available
notes.notes:
We're delighted to announce that Ecosphere has been selected to take part in the Storyteller's Festival! To mark the occasion, we've released a demo to show you a ten-minute sequence of gameplay with the essential features:

[h3]Impact assessment[/h3]

Your choices will have an impact on the universe. First of all, your decisions will shape the heroine's personality: boldness, prudence, or diplomacy, influencing your relationships with the two love interests. For example, Leily is attracted to bold girls but dislikes diplomatic behavior... A reputation system will also help you manage your relationships with NPCs.

[h3]Explore mode[/h3]

Combining both Point & Click and Drag & Drop mechanics, you can interact with the scenery to find clues and deepen the game's lore.

[h3]QTE sequences[/h3]

A dynamic choice system lets you manage action scenes as you wish. But beware: some actions are more relevant than others... Success will depend on how well you analyze the context and your environment!

We hope you enjoy this demo! Don't hesitate to share your feedback with us on social networks - it'll be a great help to us as we continue development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388138/c678be27e730c427d142c7c120e85636a545c6f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo coming soon
notes.notes:
A lot news since the summer, and we're moving ahead with the production of Ecosphere: [b]a demo is coming soon![/b] It will reveal a short sequence of the game, and you'll meet the heroine, Arane Kross, as well as her childhood friend, Zael Collin. Unless things are more ambiguous?

If you've played the Prologue, fear not! Leily Stirner, the Pirate Princess, will still be with us... For better or for worse! We hope to release the demo by the end of January 2024.

A [b]composer / sound designer[/b] specializing in orchestral and epic music is about to join the team. Gone are the days of royalty-free music; from now on, Ecosphere will be entitled to original music and a unique soundscape! A new version of the trailer soundtrack will be available soon.

We would also like to thank the [b]region Hauts-de-France[/b] for its support, which will finance a large part of the artistic direction and follow us throughout the project.

notes.title: Ecosphere - Prologue is available
notes.notes:
A prologue is available to introduce the lore and gameplay mechanics. It recounts an event taking place just before the start of the game.

The pitch is as follows: a Pirate Princess must infiltrate a memorial to steal an orb with the power to control nature: Ecosphere. Will you manage to steal the precious loot?

You can find it on its own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218720/Ecosphere__Prologue/]Steam page[/url] !

In terms of content, you'll find :

• Point & click features and the QTE battle mode
• Original UI
• A Checkpoint system: to avoid having to restart the entire game in the event of a game over. When you enter a new setting, a checkpoint is automatically activated.
• The game is fully accessible to blind people and partially sighted.

Full steam ahead!
